source: Files contained within the {0} directory are served at the root and are not modified by the build process. This is suitable for files that have to keep their names (e.g. {1}) *or* likely won't change (e.g. {2}).
text: Les fichiers contenus dans le répertoire {0} sont servis à la racine et ne sont pas modifiés par le processus de build. Cela convient aux fichiers qui doivent conserver leur nom (par ex. {1}) *ou* qui ne changeront probablement pas (par ex. {2}).
